title: Interview: MemStore’s Diwank Singh Tomer and Ishita Jindal on AI agent memory, contradictions and deletion
summary:
AI memory systems cannot guarantee that every fact will be remembered. But can they ensure that two conflicting facts are not presented without warning? MemStore explains its approach.

The post Interview: MemStore’s Diwank Singh Tomer and Ishita Jindal on AI agent memory, contradictions and deletion appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: MemStore’s co‑founders Diwank Singh Tomer and Ishita Jindal explain how their AI‑agent platform tackles the tricky problem of memory: while it’s impossible to guarantee that an agent will retain every detail, they focus on ensuring that contradictory information is flagged rather than silently presented.
